infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow SCCG App to use your camera to scan attendance QR codes and capture activity photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow SCCG App to access your photo library to attach or save activity photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Allow SCCG App to save activity photos directly to your photo library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow SCCG App to verify your location for geofenced attendance check-ins and activity logs.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow SCCG App to use your camera to scan attendance QR codes and capture workplace activity photos.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow SCCG App to verify your workplace location during attendance check-ins and activity logs.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow SCCG App to select and scan QR codes from your photo library.
Allow SCCG App to access and save activity photos to your gallery.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow SCCG App to save activity photos directly to your gallery.
